Decipher.com card scans (archive.org) for printed-card pages, swccg-guild/work#110

== Documented text state ==
This official archival digital image prints “present with” and “choose one to be lost,” matching the actual 1998 Glossary entry at [[Leia Seeker (Errata)]]. It differs from the actual first printed card scan [[:File:ANH-D-leiaseeker-hires.webp]], which prints “at same location” and “immediately lost.” The original article now uses that physical scan; this archival asset remains preserved and credited.
